title: Endless Rise Tweaks
description: Some tweaks and improvements for Endless Rise: Remastered modpack!
body:
Mod for **Endless Rise: Remastered** that's added some tweaks and improvements in modpack.
 
# Features:
- Added new type recipes for craft in the world.
- Added new items in modpack.
- Deleted ore generation from Immersive Engnineering mod.
- Deleted village house generation from Immersive Engnineering mod.
- Fixed optimizaton ItemStages mod.
